within_condition_distinct_sum_label.meaning: sum of within-condition distinct valid-sequence counts

cross_condition_overlap.numerator: For source condition A and target condition B, the number of valid canonical rows in A whose parsed sequence occurs at least once among valid canonical sequences in B.
cross_condition_overlap.denominator: The number of valid canonical rows in A. Invalid attempts stay in attempt accounting and do not enter this denominator.
cross_condition_overlap.rate: numerator divided by denominator; null when the denominator is zero, with numerator and denominator still reported
cross_condition_overlap.duplicate_policy: A repeated sequence contributes once per source row. It contributes only membership when its condition is the target. Duplicate rows are not removed or downweighted.

distinct_sequence_sensitivity.numerator: The distinct shared-sequence count |S_A intersect S_B|.
distinct_sequence_sensitivity.denominator: For directional distinct coverage, the source condition's distinct valid-sequence count. For Jaccard overlap, the distinct union count |S_A union S_B|.
distinct_sequence_sensitivity.jaccard: intersection divided by union; null when the union is zero
distinct_sequence_sensitivity.zero_denominator: A zero required denominator yields a null rate. It does not become zero.

global_sequence_free_accounting.global_distinct_valid_sequence_count: |S_B0 union S_B1 union S_B2 union S_D1|
global_sequence_free_accounting.membership_patterns: one count for each observed nonempty condition-membership pattern
global_sequence_free_accounting.reconciliation: membership-pattern counts sum to the global union size

exact_train_leakage.numerator: Valid generated rows whose full parsed sequence belongs to the caller-supplied TRAIN core set.
exact_train_leakage.train_cores: nonempty canonical ^[ACGU]+$ strings supplied in memory
exact_train_leakage.duplicate_train_cores: refused; duplicates are not silently removed
exact_train_leakage.distinct_sequence_sensitivity: matching distinct generated sequences divided by distinct valid generated sequences
exact_train_leakage.zero_denominator: A zero required denominator yields a null rate except for the frozen D1 seed report, which fails closed.

d1.missing_seed_or_zero_valid_denominator: explicit failure; not replaced with a pooled estimate

nearest_train_normalized_edit_distance.numerator: Global Levenshtein distance to the nearest supplied TRAIN core.
nearest_train_normalized_edit_distance.denominator: Length of the longer of the valid generated sequence and that TRAIN core.
nearest_train_normalized_edit_distance.maximum_edit_similarity: one minus the nearest normalized distance
nearest_train_normalized_edit_distance.distinct_sequence_projection: Compute the distance once per distinct generated sequence and project it back to rows.

pooled_equal_mixture_distance_quantile.weight: 1 / (participating seeds × valid rows for that seed)
pooled_equal_mixture_distance_quantile.absent_when: A required D1 seed is missing, or a D1 seed has a zero valid-row count. The existing weight is undefined at a zero valid-row count, and dropping that seed would be a different rule.
